CustomField.formula: IF( MONTH(DATEVALUE( CreatedDate )) >= 1 && MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate )) <= 4, "Cuatrimestre 1", IF( MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate )) >= 5 && MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate )) <= 8, "Cuatrimestre 2", IF( MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate )) >= 9 && MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate )) <= 12, "Cuatrimestre 3", "No definido" ) ) )
CustomField.label: Cuatrimestre
